evaluation_basis: Assessed as a constrained real-data replication across configurations; missing repository provenance is explicitly downgraded.
original_objective: Evaluate the cross-sectional/feature design on deep CoinEx BTC/USDT 4h history across multiple folds, seeds, horizons and cost stresses.

engineering_result.summary: A real-data, multi-configuration experiment with stress costs and bootstrap uncertainty was recorded; historical OI/order-flow inputs were unavailable.

scientific_result.summary: All 24 configurations failed promotion; the best point estimate had uncertainty spanning zero.

economic_result.summary: Best mean-Sharpe arm, 24h ridge logistic plus basis/funding, returned -2.71%, Sharpe 0.222 and -8.44% at 15 bps stress; bootstrap CI [-0.001537, 0.001214].

contribution_to_next_version: Reinforced rejection discipline and motivated a unified evidence/risk/execution contract before further model tournaments.
